warnings.label: Christchurch Harbour
warnings.message:
High tides today may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 2200 to 2359 on 30 August 2026 
Locations most affected will be coastal roads and footpaths. There may be water onto the quay and footpaths around Old Mill Tearooms at Quomps (Christchurch) recreation area. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid coastal footpaths, which may be flooded . 
This message will be updated by 2:53PM on 31 August 2026 or as the situation changes.

warnings.label: South Cornwall coast from Lizard Point to Gribbin Head excluding the Tidal Fal Estuary
warnings.description: South Cornwall coast from Lizard Point to Gribbin Head excluding the Tidal Fal Estuary
warnings.eaArea: Devon, Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly
warnings.message:
High tides tomorrow evening may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible 2 hours either side of high tide on Sunday evening 30th of August. High tide at Falmouth is at 19:26 
Areas particularly at risk include low lying coastal communities including Cadgwith and Coverack, Porthallow, the tidal Helford Estuary, Maenporth and Swanpool, St.Mawes, East Portholland, Gorran Haven,  Portmellon, Mevagissey, Pentewan and Par.
Forecast total high tide level is 2.7m AOD. Expect tides to be between 300-310mm over tide table level. Expect force 6 SW winds and wave heights of over 2m.
Coastal conditions should ease by Monday mornings high tide. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded . 
This message will be updated by 1:00PM on 31 August 2026 or as the situation changes.

Flooding is possible 2 hours either side of high tide on Saturday 29th August evening and Sunday 30th August evening. 
Areas particularly at risk include low lying areas including Fore Street, Town Quay, Albert Quay and Caffa Mill Car park at Fowey, Quay Street and Recreation ground at Lostwithiel, Polperro Harbour, Quay Road and The Quay at Looe and the B3247 at Seaton.

We are closely monitoring the situation .

This message will be updated by 11:00AM on 31 August 2026 or as the situation changes.

warnings.label: Hunstanton coast in Norfolk
warnings.message:
High tides tomorrow morning may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 07:00 am to 11:00 am on Monday 31 August. 
Areas most at risk are around Hunstanton seafront. Flood gates in the area will be closed by the Local Authority which will make access difficult. The detailed forecast is for a peak level at King's Lynn of 4.39mAODN at 09:00am on 31 August 2026, Wind Force 5, Westerly. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid beaches and coastal promenades, which may be flooded . 
This message will be updated by 11:00AM on 31 August 2026 or as the situation changes.

warnings.label: Somerset coast at Porlock Weir
warnings.message:
There is no longer a threat of flooding, though standing water and debris may still remain. 
Tidal conditions are expected to improve and no flooding is expected.   
We will continue to monitor the situation and will issue further alerts or warnings if necessary.   
If you have been evacuated only return to your property once the emergency services have advised that it is safe to do so. Never drive through flood water,  just 30cm of fast flowing water is enough to move your car.

warnings.label: Beaulieu estuary
warnings.message:
High tides on Monday may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible for 1 hour either side of Monday's early morning tide at 01:13 on 31/08/2026 and 03:30 on 31/08/2026 
The weather increases tide table values by 0.5 m. Total forecast tide is 4.02 metres Chart Datum (2.20 mAOD) at Beaulieu. Light South Westerly Force 4 wind. The tide will flood into the garden of the Mill House on the downstream side of the Mill Pond. Minor road flooding at Palace Lane is also expected, making access to the village temporarily more difficult. Monday's tide at 13:36 on 31/08/2026 is forecast to be 12 cm lower (2.08 mAOD). 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid using low lying footpaths and any bridges near local watercourses . 
This message will be updated by 3:00PM on 31 August 2026 or as the situation changes.
